        Dear Jeffrey,
        I wanted to update you on our placebo initiative at Harvard. I've been asked to
        start a Harvard-wide Program in Placebo Studies which will be hosted at the Beth
        Israel Deaconess Medical Center. It will do basic, clinical and social science
        research as well as scholarly work in placebo studies. We are situated in all the
        major teaching hospitals at Harvard and have already drawn commitments from
        over 20 faculty. Anne Harrington will be joining us. We recently published an
        physiological study of placebo in the New England Journal of Medicine and a
        theoretical paper in Philosophic Transactions of the Roy Soc B. (I'm attaching
        fyi). We anticipate making some major breakthroughs in genetic of placebo
        effects (were submitting our findings in the next days) and have major studies in
        the pipeline. We're hoping that this program will establish Placebo Studies as a
        important component of medical research internationally. Here is our new
        websitc: ww.programinplacebostudies.org. Let me know if this is of any
        interest for you.

Sincerely,

Ted


       Ted J. Kaptchuk
       Associate Professor of Medicine
Harvard Medical School
Director, Program in Placebo Studies & Therapeutic Encounter
Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center
Boston. MA 02215
